causal_question: On the already-consumed Figurines development sentinel, is the remaining LERF3D gap caused by the 0.15-radian bound, by the single-center output, or by a mismatch between teacher fidelity and text-query ranking?

teacher_view_authority.source_views: the exact 120 selected_frame_indices sealed by source_view_mpr metadata
teacher_view_authority.target_exclusion: the four official Figurines evaluation frames 41,105,152,195 remain excluded
teacher_view_authority.per_view_descriptor: exact raster-contribution weighted source RADIO observation for one primitive, followed by the singleton official C-RADIOv4 SigLIP2-G summary head and FP32 L2 normalization
teacher_view_authority.retention: for every AcceptedV2 row retain at most four visible source views by descending exact contribution mass; ties use ascending immutable frame id
teacher_view_authority.view_weights: equal mass after visibility-based retention, matching the existing multiview teacher objective

oracle_definitions.O0: immutable AcceptedV2 e0 at each of the three frozen radii
oracle_definitions.O1: closed-form geodesic projection of O0 toward the normalized equal-view teacher mean, capped at 0.15 radians
oracle_definitions.O2: normalized equal-view teacher mean without an angular cap

O3.fit: deterministic permutation-invariant spherical k-means; farthest-pair initialization; fixed four iterations; empty modes retain their deterministic seed; modes canonically ordered by descending membership then descriptor SHA-256
O3.query_aggregation: beta^-1 log(sum_k pi_k exp(beta*cos(u_k,q))) with beta=10 and empirical mode frequencies pi

oracle_definitions.O4: the same beta=10 normalized log-sum-exp over every retained per-view teacher response with equal view weights
oracle_definitions.fallback: rows with no retained teacher view remain bitwise O0; one-view rows use that one teacher descriptor for O1-O4

control_and_stop_rules.bounded_single_center_stop: If O1 does not improve both AP and oracle IoU over O0, stop the current bounded V1 residual line.
control_and_stop_rules.distributional_stop: If O3 does not improve over O2 on AP and oracle IoU without a fixed-mIoU regression above 0.01, do not build a distributional region head.
control_and_stop_rules.proxy_mismatch: If query-free teacher fidelity improves but AP/oracle IoU do not, prioritize query-response/listwise training rather than more capacity.
